milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.summary: The application as it runs today: projects, 2D sheets with P&ID symbols and lines, attributes, history and undo, floating windows, and Alex in the chat. Every action is one command, used the same way by the interface, Alex, and outside agents, with a local-first AI policy.

stages.title: Refactoring: tests, one domain model, server modules, migrations, the server as the only writer
stages.tryIt: The code was restructured and covered by tests. The app looks and works as before.

stages.title: Follow-up: per-user state, frontend structure, types
stages.tryIt: Per-user state and code structure. Nothing new on screen.

stages.title: One command registry, safe AI edits, local-first AI
stages.tryIt: In Alex's Agent tab, with the mode on Agent, ask Alex to change a sheet and use Undo on its reply (or tick Review changes first and use Apply / Discard).

stages.title: Parity tests, enforcement, and the evaluation set for AI models
stages.tryIt: Tests that the interface, Alex, and outside agents run the same commands. Nothing new on screen.

stages.title: Back and Forward in the menu bar
stages.tryIt: In Configuration → Content and standards, click Classes on a package, then the left arrow right of Help (or Alt+Left, ⌘[ on a Mac): you are back on Content and standards; the right arrow goes forward again.

stages.title: Feedback beside Help
stages.tryIt: Click Feedback in the menu bar: choose Problem, Idea, Praise or Other, rate E1 if you like, type or press the microphone and speak, paste a screenshot or attach a PDF or a short clip, keep Attach my last actions ticked, and Send.

milestones.title: Object model
milestones.summary: Every engineering thing becomes one object with one owner, a class from a versioned library, attributes with sub-attributes and units, and typed relationships to other objects across sections. The library defines how objects behave (where they may live, what they may contain and relate to), and every tool follows the same rules. Tags come from the project's own naming rules. Today's symbols move into signed content packages as records, and every command works object by object, ready for the database of M2.

stages.title: Parity, enforcement, and the evaluation set
stages.tryIt: Parity checks and the AI evaluation set. Nothing new on screen.

stages.title: Test automation pipeline (CI)
stages.tryIt: Every test now runs automatically on each change (GitHub Actions). Nothing new in the app.

stages.title: Content packages and the library
stages.tryIt: The symbols now come from signed content packages. The symbol picker and the sheets look exactly as before; asking Alex which symbols exist gives the same list.

stages.title: Symbols as content package records, drawn by one renderer (formerly M1.9)
stages.tryIt: Nothing should look different: every symbol is now drawn from its record in the content packages. Open Insert > Asset and page through the types, place a few symbols on a sheet and connect them, and open Model Space: all should look exactly as before.

stages.title: Record-level store and the object model migration
stages.tryIt: Mostly under the hood. Open an existing project: the tree, sheets, and History should look as before, and every edit (and Alex) should still work.

stages.title: Content packages visible in project settings
stages.tryIt: Select a project and choose File > Project settings: its content packages (Core, Electrical foundation, and Plant engineering, which includes instrumentation & control) are listed with versions and what requires each. Ask Alex which content packages the project uses, or what you can place from Plant.

stages.title: Tree from ownership, move and delete with preview
stages.tryIt: In the tree, assets appear under Assets, nothing is listed under their sheets, and under each asset its drawings are listed as shortcuts: double-click one to open that drawing with the asset in view. Drag an object to a folder, delete an object and read the preview of what goes with it, then undo through History.

stages.title: Classes, attributes, sub-attributes, creating objects
stages.tryIt: Right-click Assets, choose New asset… and create a Centrifugal pump: its page marks Design pressure and Flow rate as required. Set 10 bar(g), a value under Design pressure / In, and Add attribute; New system… offers no pump.

stages.title: Relationships between objects
stages.tryIt: Create a function under Systems (New system…), and on its Relationships tab choose "is implemented by", pick a pump in the tree and Add: the pump shows under the function. Or drag the pump onto the function with the right mouse button.

stages.title: Tags and reference designations
stages.tryIt: Create a few pumps under Assets without a name: they become P-001, P-002 with the designation -P. Change a pump's short code and see its tag marked out of date; right-click it, Tag…, type a manual tag; then More (…) > Retag… with the preview.

stages.title: Tag configurator
stages.tryIt: Open File > Project settings: under Tag rules, add a rule for pumps (text PU, then the number from 101), watch the sample, Test against project, Save rules, then create a pump under Assets and see it tagged PU-101.

stages.title: Columns in the explorer
stages.tryIt: In the explorer, … → Columns…: under General Add Class and Status; under Attributes type press (Pressure comes first) and Add Flow rate; every pump shows them beside its name, up to five, in the order set with ← and →.

stages.title: Place on drawing: a drawing picker, and Pick the spot
stages.tryIt: Right-click an instrument under Assets → Place on drawing…: find a P&ID by number, title or folder (drawings with no fitting shape are left out), then Pick the spot and click where it goes, into a pipe when on one. Ctrl-click several objects first to place them in turn.

stages.title: New … at every level of the explorer, and icons for what E1 keeps
stages.tryIt: Right-click a system → New system…, then right-click the new one for the next level: each shows inside the one above. Under Assets, the folders E1 keeps (Pipelines, Cables and wires, Signal lines, Hookups) are filled, your own outlined; cables, pipelines and streams have icons of their own.

stages.title: Projects: every project as a card, only yours in the explorer
stages.tryIt: Click Projects on the left rail: every project is a card with a picture of a sheet. Remove from Explorer on one card (or right-click a project in the tree): it leaves the tree, and a link below the tree counts it. Add to Explorer, Open, or a new project brings one in.

milestones.title: Platform
milestones.summary: E1 moves onto PostgreSQL and into the vendor's cloud. People sign in, belong to organizations, and are invited to projects with roles down to a single section or drawing. Two engineers can work in the same project at the same time without overwriting each other, Alex's proposals are kept safely on the server, and the technical security baseline is in place.

stages.title: PostgreSQL store with the object and history tables
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: with npm run db:up, db:migrate, and db:seed, then E1_STORE=postgres, projects open and edit as before, stored in PostgreSQL tables that keep each organization apart.

stages.title: Accounts and sign-in
stages.tryIt: Start npm run dev:identity and the server with E1_AUTH=oidc (README): the sign-in screen appears; the first sign-in claims the installation, a second email gets its own empty workspace.

stages.title: Import of existing workspaces
stages.tryIt: Run npm run db:import -- data/db.json, start the server on PostgreSQL, and open it: the tree, sheets, history, and your chat are all there.

stages.title: Organizations, invitations, and license tables
stages.tryIt: On the server with sign-in on, open File > Organization…, invite a colleague by email, open the link signed in as them, and see them listed with their license and the seats used.

stages.title: Project permissions
stages.tryIt: Open a project and choose Members: give a colleague Reviewer; signed in as them, the project opens but moving a symbol is refused with the permission it needs.

stages.title: Live refresh, safe saves per object, and stored proposals
stages.tryIt: Sign in as two people on one project in two browsers: a rename in one appears in the other without reloading; a reply held for review is still there to apply after the server restarts.

stages.title: File storage
stages.tryIt: On the server, attach a file to a chat message or upload one to a project, reload the page, and open it again; signed in as someone without a role in the project, it is not found.

stages.title: Reference cloud deployment
stages.tryIt: Open https://app.lanxtor.com in a normal browser, without installing anything, and sign in: the status bar (bottom right) says Microsoft Azure.

stages.title: Technical security baseline and the M2 gate
stages.tryIt: Mostly under the hood: security settings and checks. You may notice session timeouts and stricter sign-in rules.

milestones.title: Lists and connectivity
milestones.summary: Pipes, cables, wires, and signals become objects connected to ports. Any list is a live table of the model: right-click any node, Query ▸ New query… lists every object below it, in an Excel-like query view that can be filtered, edited, saved as a template (then listed under Query ▸), and exported to Excel. There are no fixed lists. The large 2D drawing editor arrives here. After M3, a first informal pilot preview.

stages.title: The drawing migration: lines as objects, placements in 2D
stages.tryIt: Open a drawn sheet: it looks and edits as before. Under Assets, open Pipelines, Signal lines or Cables and wires: each drawn pipe run, signal, cable, or wire is an object with its own attributes; drawing a second pipe to a nozzle that already has one is refused.

stages.title: The 2D sheet view
stages.tryIt: Open a sheet: the drawing as SVG. Scroll to zoom about the pointer, drag to pan, Fit to see it all, and click a symbol to select it.

stages.title: Editing on the 2D view
stages.tryIt: On a sheet: click and Shift-click to select, drag to move, drag on empty sheet to frame a selection; draw with Connector, add a note with Text, place a symbol from Place symbol…; F flips, Delete deletes, Align lines several up, the grips resize; Pan, Grid, Snap, and Ortho are in the bar.

stages.title: Undo, redo, copy, paste, and the editing commands
stages.tryIt: Undo and redo across the drawing, the tree, and attributes; copy, paste, and duplicate symbols with their tags.

stages.title: Query view: read-only table
stages.tryIt: Right-click a project or section, New query…: a table of the objects below it; click a header to sort, Columns to add attributes.

stages.title: Query view: filters, templates, and expressions
stages.tryIt: Filter with AND/OR/NOT, read the plain-language summary, and save the view as a template for yourself or the project.

stages.title: Query view: editing like Excel
stages.tryIt: Type, paste from Excel, and fill down in the table; one undo restores a whole paste.

stages.title: Jobs: spreadsheet export and import with preview
stages.tryIt: Export a table to Excel, change a cell, then Update from Excel…: Check shows exactly that change, Apply makes it.

stages.title: Engineering columns
stages.tryIt: Right-click Assets, Query ▸ New query…; in Columns add Designation and Connects to; Group & totals by Class; save it as your equipment list: it is under Query ▸ from then on. F2 on an owner cell moves the object.

stages.title: On the drawing: tags, line numbers, others' changes, layers
stages.tryIt: On a sheet, each symbol shows its tag and each tagged or named run its line number; Layers hides Process, Instrumentation, Electrical, or Annotation on this sheet.

stages.title: The 2D view becomes the sheet view
stages.tryIt: Open any sheet: it is the 2D view, with flow arrows and line crossings, the right-click menus, name labels to drag, formatting, frames, predictive mode, and Layers.

stages.title: Instrumentation symbols in the Plant package
stages.tryIt: Open Configuration → Shapes and search for gauge: the instrument, valve and logic shapes are there. Place a pressure gauge from the asset window: it is tagged PG-001.

stages.title: Copy and paste between sheets and projects, through Copy temp
stages.tryIt: Copy a pump on a sheet, open a sheet of another project (in this window or another tab) and paste: the new pump, with its values, is in Assets ▸ Copy temp, and the area it was in is in Areas ▸ Copy temp. Drag them where they belong: Copy temp disappears once it is empty.

milestones.title: Documents
milestones.summary: Datasheets designed by the users: each object has its datasheet, where values are viewed and edited, and the same layout prints. Documents with revisions and issues, PDF of 2D spaces, lists, and datasheets with a title block, Excel import, search, object history, comments, tasks, generated loop diagrams, Alex's engineering patterns, redlining (markups on a 2D space, review rounds, marked-up prints), specification attributes for instruments, and document control (versions and revisions on the sheet, changes since a date, clouds in outputs). Everyone sees who else has the same sheet open (presence; no live pointers). M4 ends with pilot readiness: access control first (permissions by category, custom roles, who sees what, objects assigned to a person or group, an exportable access history), then a second cloud, billing, a signed desktop app, passkeys, and the security and legal reviews a pilot partner needs.

stages.title: Object history and search
stages.tryIt: Rename a pump, open it, and see the change on its History tab with the name before and after; Undo this change takes it back. Search the explorer for a tag, a name, or a line number.

stages.title: Documents and revisions
stages.tryIt: Right-click Documents → New document…, make a list, and add revisions A and B on its page; set B in review. The Documents section shows Updated for someone who has not looked yet.

stages.title: List documents, PDF, and Excel
stages.tryIt: Choose a saved query for a list document, then download its PDF and its Excel workbook: both carry the project, the document, its revision, and the date.

stages.title: The datasheet as the object's screen
stages.tryIt: Double-click an object and click Data sheet, or right-click its symbol → Open ▸ Datasheet: view and edit its values there.

stages.title: Datasheet designer
stages.tryIt: Open the datasheet designer, change a datasheet layout, and see objects of that class use it.

stages.title: P&ID sheet PDF
stages.tryIt: Open a sheet and choose File → Export PDF or press Ctrl+P: the sheet prints on its page format with its title block.

stages.title: Issue and "changed since"
stages.tryIt: Issue Rev A of a pump list, change a pump's design pressure, and see "Changed since Rev A" on the list and Modified on the pump in the explorer.

stages.title: Comments, tasks, mentions, and notifications
stages.tryIt: Write in a pump's Chat tab with an @mention, reply, and like; New task… assigns it, and the Inbox marks it done. Right-click the pump on its 2D space → Pin a message here: it shows Needs review in the explorer until you Resolve the pin.

stages.title: List PDF and update from Excel
stages.tryIt: Print a list to PDF, and update a list from a changed Excel file with a preview.

stages.title: Generated loop diagrams
stages.tryIt: Relate a transmitter and a controller to a loop function (implements) and let it control a valve; right-click the function → Loop diagrams ▸ Generate loop diagram. Move the transmitter, add a device to the loop, press Regenerate: the move stays. A line drawn between two devices becomes a signal in the model.

stages.title: Engineering patterns for Alex
stages.tryIt: Ask Alex for "a redundant pump train on the feed line", "a pressure transmitter on Pump1", or "a motor for Pump2 fed from the MCC": it draws the pattern, checks it, and says what it repaired.

stages.title: Document control: versions and revisions on the sheet
stages.tryIt: Click a 2D space: Create revision… with a purpose (Rev A for IFA, Rev 0 for IFC), then Prepared, Checked and Approved sign and it is issued and filed. Create version… gives an internal C.1. Delete… leaves a record; Project settings → Documents sets the numbering.

stages.title: Document control: changes since a date on the drawing
stages.tryIt: Open a 2D space and click Changes since… (Shift+C), then Last 7 days or Last revision: every change since then has a cloud, added, deleted, modified or moved, and its card shows before → after and who changed it. The chip opens the Changes list.

stages.title: Document control: clouds in generated outputs
stages.tryIt: Change a 2D space after Rev A and create Rev B: its PDF clouds the change with a triangle and lists it in Changes in this revision. Compare with… on a row lists the changes between two outputs; Show changes on the drawing clouds them on the 2D space.

stages.title: Redlining: the markup layer and its tools
stages.tryIt: Click Markup on a 2D space, choose an intent and draw a cloud around a pump, an arrow and a text: the drawing does not change, the cloud links the pump, its card has the discussion, and Layers → Markups hides them.

stages.title: Redlining: review rounds, status, and the markups list
stages.tryIt: Markups list → New review round, draw markups in it (A-001), Submit my markups; answer each with Set status (Accept, Reject with a reason, Answer), Close round, and Export the comment resolution sheet.

stages.title: Redlining: markups on revisions, and marked-up prints
stages.tryIt: Mark up B beside a plot document's revision, move a marked valve and see Δ on its markup, then Markups list → Marked-up print: the PDF has the markups, a legend and the watermark; issuing ignores them.

stages.title: Specification attributes and classes for instruments
stages.tryIt: Make an Electromagnetic flowmeter or a pressure transmitter: its Attributes tab has the specification data of its datasheet (ranges, output signal, wetted materials, enclosure), and its process connection port its size and rating. Pumps and exchangers have their API data too.

stages.title: Pilot readiness: organization export, seat notices, customer-cloud path
stages.tryIt: As an owner, Organization… → Export → Export everything…, confirm with your passkey: the archive of the whole organization downloads. Assigning the license that fills 80 % or 100 % of the seats puts a notice in the Inbox of every owner and administrator.

stages.title: Access control: hardening of the permission checks
stages.tryIt: A sheet's Share no longer offers Project administrator, and a role there needs a role on the project to open it. Behind it: no grant reaches another project, and nobody grants more than they hold.

stages.title: Access control: permissions by category, ceilings, and custom roles
stages.tryIt: Organization… → Access → Roles: copy Engineer, untick Delete diagrams, save, and give it to a group in Members: a member is refused deleting a sheet. Admit a colleague with at most Engineer: higher roles are greyed out.

stages.title: Access control: who sees what (reviewers and viewers)
stages.tryIt: Project settings → Access → Visible to: Editors only hides the project from reviewers and viewers. Right-click an attribute row on an object → Hide from viewers: signed in as a viewer, the row is not there.

stages.title: Access control: objects assigned to a person or group
stages.tryIt: On a pump's page, Responsible → Assign to… a colleague (or Take it): signed in as someone else, its values are read-only with the reason, and moving it or connecting a line to it is refused.

stages.title: Access control: access history, audit export, reviews, and emergency access
stages.tryIt: Change a group and a role, then File → Organization… → Access → History: both show with before and after. Pick a date under Access on a date, Show access then, and Export access report (Excel).

stages.title: Privacy: history shows groups instead of names
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Privacy → Groups only: the history of every project, sheet and object shows the groups of the person who made each change, not their name. Names of people shows the names again.

stages.title: Presence: who has this sheet open
stages.tryIt: Open the same 2D space as a colleague in two browsers: each sees the other's avatar in the sheet toolbar, with a pencil while they edit; it is gone within a minute after they close the sheet. Configuration → Privacy → Show who has a sheet open turns it off.

stages.title: Pilot readiness: invoices, payment, and billing
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes for customers: invoices with gapless numbers and a PDF are made and sent each period, paid by bank transfer or by card through the pay link (Stripe). See the operator console's Billing.

stages.title: Pilot readiness: penetration test, DPA, and sub-processors
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: the data processing agreement and the sub-processor list are on the website (lanxtor.com/dpa.html, sub-processors.html), with notice of changes from the operator console; open: the lawyer's review of the DPA and an outside penetration test with its findings fixed.

stages.title: Pilot readiness: signed desktop app that updates itself
stages.tryIt: Install the Mac app from Get E1: macOS opens it without a warning (signed and notarized), and a newer version installs itself. The Windows installer is signed in the build too.

stages.title: Pilot readiness: standards rights
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: the datasheet templates are E1's own, only inspired by ISA, API and ASME datasheets, with nothing of their forms used, so no legal review is needed (the owner's decision).

stages.title: Enterprise installation on Alibaba Cloud: file storage
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: E1 stores files in Alibaba Cloud OSS through its S3-compatible interface (virtual-hosted addresses, chosen by itself for an endpoint on aliyuncs.com, or E1_S3_ADDRESSING=virtual). See deploy/README.md, "Alibaba Cloud".

stages.title: Pilot readiness: terms and license agreement before first use
stages.tryIt: Open E1 as a new user: the E1 Terms and License Agreement comes first, and only its checkbox and Accept and continue open E1. Help → Terms and conditions shows it and its PDF; lanxtor.com/e1-terms.html has it too, and every invoice links there.

stages.title: Deep view: an object and everything associated with it
stages.tryIt: Open a valve on a drawn 2D space → Deep view: its card and the pipes on its ports ("connects to (inlet)"). Click + on a pipe for the pump beyond, Expand all to the end of the network, then click the pump and Highlight route.

stages.title: The Documents section's filter by kind
stages.tryIt: Click Documents in the explorer and choose Drawings in the All ▾ filter: only the 2D spaces and plots are listed, with the folders; Lists and Datasheets show theirs.

stages.title: Diagrams tab: small pictures of the diagrams an object is drawn on
stages.tryIt: Open a valve on a drawn 2D space → Diagrams: a picture of each diagram it is drawn on, the valve ringed, with the diagram's full path below. Double-click a picture to open the diagram with the valve selected.

milestones.title: Library lifecycle
milestones.summary: Companies edit and publish their own library: classes, attributes, relationship types, and how they behave. Projects see which updates are available and upgrade with a preview. Equipment catalogs with manufacturer data, a symbol designer with SVG import and live attribute labels, units of measurement, switching, licensing, and updates of content packages, specification datasheets (components, cases, templates inspired by ISA and API datasheets), and document control's sheet templates, sign-off routes, reports and filing.

stages.title: Library editor: draft, review, publish
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Company library: make an attribute (a choice of values) and a class that is a kind of Centrifugal pump with that attribute, save them as drafts, publish. The class is then in Object classes, New object offers it, and E1 checks its owners like its own classes.

stages.title: Updates available, checked against projects
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Company library: publish a second version of a company class; Updates available in this project lists its objects still on version 1 and what changed. Save a draft that removes a choice or narrows where a class may be owned, and Check against projects lists every object it would break.

stages.title: Upgrade with preview
stages.tryIt: Publish a new version of a company class, then Configuration → Company library → Preview upgrade: each object is upgraded, has values retired, or is skipped with the reason; Upgrade applies it as one change. A retired value shows with Discard and cannot be edited.

stages.title: Project library and convention templates
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Company library: tick one project, choose For projects: Only that project and publish a class only this project has. Publish a convention template, Apply to this project, then publish a new version: the project keeps its rules until you apply it again.

stages.title: The library editor from every Configuration section, and attributes from a standard
stages.tryIt: In Object classes, New subclass on a class opens the company library with its parent chosen; Allow a shape and New group extend it. In Attributes, Import from a standard reads a spreadsheet into drafts.

stages.title: Company catalogs and items
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Catalogs: create a catalog, add a pump item with manufacturer, model, ordering code and a flow rate, Publish it, then New version, change the flow rate, and Publish again: both versions stay.

stages.title: Create objects from catalog items
stages.tryIt: New asset… on Assets: choose Centrifugal pump, then a catalog item under From catalog. The pump opens with the item's values and From catalog: … above them; change a value and it is marked as differing from the catalog.

stages.title: Catalog updates, re-apply, replace, detach
stages.tryIt: Publish a new version of a catalog item used by pumps: Company library → Updates available lists it. Re-apply…: a value changed by hand is kept unless ticked; Apply, then Edit → Undo. On a pump, Detach keeps its values.

stages.title: Project and content package catalogs
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Catalogs: tick one project, New catalog with For projects: Only that project, add and publish an item, and make an object from it. Open another project: its catalogs do not list it.

stages.title: Catalog import
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Catalogs → a catalog → Import…: pick a vendor Excel or CSV list, Dry run to see each row, Import (drafts only), then Publish the drafts. Import the list again after changing one row: only that row becomes a new version.

stages.title: Symbol designer and publishing
stages.tryIt: Right-click a pump on a sheet → Shape ▸ Modify shape…: draw a line in the designer and Save and use here; the pump is drawn with this project's copy. Or Configuration → Shapes → New shape or Derive, then Publish and Allow for a class.

stages.title: Attribute labels on symbols
stages.tryIt: Right-click a pump → Shape ▸ Modify shape… → Label: choose Design pressure / In, click under the pump, Save and use here. The sheet shows its value; change the value and the label follows; File → Export PDF shows it too.

stages.title: SVG import into the symbol designer
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Shapes → Import SVG…: choose an SVG of a symbol. The designer opens with a report (what was imported and left out) and two suggested connection points; choose what it draws and Publish.

stages.title: Symbol versions on placements and upgrade
stages.tryIt: Publish a new version of a company shape: the sheets keep the old one. Configuration → Company library → Updates available lists the shape; Preview placement upgrade, then Upgrade N; one undo takes it back.

stages.title: Units of measurement
stages.tryIt: File → Project settings… → Units: choose Imperial. A new flow rate offers ft³/h first; type only the number. Choose another unit for a value: Convert or Change unit only. (The Model Space 3D view is archived.)

stages.title: Switching content packages on and off
stages.tryIt: File → Project settings… → Content packages: switch Plant engineering off in a project with pumps: E1 lists what still uses it and keeps it. In an empty project switch it off: New asset… and the symbol picker no longer offer pumps.

stages.title: Project templates: save a project as a template, start a project from one
stages.tryIt: Right-click a project → Save as template…; Configuration → Project templates lists it. File → New project from a template…: choose it, name the project and Create project: a copy with everything in it; changing the copy leaves the template as it was.

stages.title: Content package licensing
stages.tryIt: File → Organization… → Content packages: which packages your subscription includes and who a per-person package is assigned to. An object of a package that is not licensed is read only, with the reason, and can still be exported.

stages.title: Content package updates
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Company library: when E1 ships newer content packages, Updates available lists them per package with what changed. Preview package update, then Update: the project reads the new versions; nothing changes until you take it.

stages.title: The NORSOK SCD content package
stages.tryIt: Project settings → Content packages: switch NORSOK SCD on. On a System control diagram place MA and LB, draw a Signal from MA's AHH to LB's X, then right-click → Check SCD…: nothing to report; MA's Y to LB's XS is an error.

stages.title: Sheet templates
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Sheet templates: copy ISO A1 landscape, change its title block cells, and publish it. Choose it in Project settings → Documents: the next revision prints on it, and the 2D space shows its frame and title block in grey.

stages.title: Configurable sign-off routes and audit
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Sign-off routes: copy one, add a step with its days to sign, publish it and choose it for IFA in Project settings → Documents. Send a revision through it, Reassign… a step to a colleague, and save the Audit report from the Document control card.

stages.title: Reports, PDF packages, and filing rules
stages.tryIt: Add to report… on two saved queries, then Export PDF. Right-click Documents → New PDF package, add issued documents, Generate package. Configuration → Numbering, Purposes of issue and Filing: copy one, publish it, choose it in Project settings → Documents.

stages.title: Datasheet components: field tables, row lists, column repeaters
stages.tryIt: Open a pump in a specification layout: numbered lines, a nozzle list with + Add row and ×, rows beyond the printed ones on a continuation page, a column per stage in bands; Export PDF prints the same pages.

stages.title: Operating cases on the datasheet
stages.tryIt: On a pump's datasheet, + Add case, type the case's flow and see the rest inherited (pale); Reset inherits again. Issue its datasheet document, change a value: that line shows the next revision.

stages.title: Instrument datasheet templates inspired by ISA datasheets
stages.tryIt: Make an Electromagnetic flowmeter: its datasheet opens in its template, inspired by ISA specification datasheets, with its operating parameters, and says so at the foot of each page.

stages.title: Equipment datasheet templates inspired by API
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Datasheets → Centrifugal pump specification (inspired by API datasheets) → Use for this project: every centrifugal pump opens in it. Exchangers have theirs too.

stages.title: The datasheet designer for people
stages.tryIt: Copy a standard template with Copy to edit…, add components, set Applies when, preview several objects; when its source changes, Compare with source and Take over selected.

stages.title: Datasheets for several tags at once

milestones.title: Piping

Double-click one of its lines: the pipeline is selected; again, its segment.

milestones.title: Rules and stored assistants
milestones.summary: Rule-based engineering without programming: values calculated from other values and from related objects, copy rules that fill values from their source, and check rules that find problems and can block issuing a revision. Built together with stored assistants (owner, 2026-11-09, 00-D13): repeatable procedures saved from Alex's turn or recorded by hand, shared, and run with one click.

stages.title: Rule engine and calculations on the object
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Rules → New rule: a motor's rated current from its rated output, voltage, power factor and efficiency (Calculate, with units), Save draft, Publish. On the motor's page the value shows ƒ and Why this value?; change its voltage and the current follows.

stages.title: Calculations through relationships
stages.tryIt: In Configuration → Rules, give an input the source Related object's attribute (an instrument's function code), or count a tank's instruments with All, as a list and Aggregate. Change the related object or relate another: the value follows at once.

stages.title: Check rules and findings

stages.title: Copy rules

stages.title: Rules everywhere, tag configurator on the engine

stages.title: Stored assistants: sharing

stages.title: Instruction assistants
stages.tryIt: In Assistants click New instruction assistant…, write what Alex should do for the selected object, select one and click Preview: Alex does it with only the tools it may use, and you Apply or Discard.

milestones.title: EI&C: wiring and loop diagrams

stages.title: Physical layer: cabinets, cards, terminals, cables, and cores

Make a cable from a catalog cable type, right-click a core → Wiring tools ▸ Connect to terminal…, then Trace circuit.

stages.title: Loop diagrams with terminals

stages.title: Signals and wiring typicals

milestones.title: Modules: modular P&ID design
milestones.summary: Modules made from a selection on any P&ID, kept with versions in the company or project library, placed in one step from the Modules tab with tags from the rules, and their instances kept in step: E1 takes what the module changed, keeps what an instance changed, and asks about every conflict. stages.title: Place modules from the Modules tab

stages.title: Paste carries values and whole instances

stages.title: Edit modules: new versions, upgrade, duplicate, copy to the company

stages.title: Promote an instance's changes to the module

stages.title: Modules in the integration API

stages.tryIt: Configuration → Modules: click a published module, Edit on a sheet. A sheet Edit module: … opens with it placed and selected; change it, Save changes to module… and Publish make v2; Close sheet deletes the sheet.

stages.tryIt: Configuration → Modules: New version on a module. stages.title: Rules that choose a module
stages.tryIt: Give two block valve modules of one category a 2 in and a 6 in inlet, set a pipe's Nominal size to DN 150 and click the 2 in module onto it: the 6 in one is placed, and placing says why (Alex: choose_module).

milestones.title: Workflow and dashboards

stages.title: Exit criteria, approvals, and overrides

stages.title: Flow editor and workflow versions
stages.tryIt: In Configuration → Workflows click Flow on a workflow and Add path… from In design to Vendor data, only when a value says small change. Publish a version without Ready for check, map it to In design under Workflow updates and take it.

stages.title: Dashboards for the environment and the project
stages.tryIt: Click Dashboards on the left rail: Project progress shows progress, items by step and required values missing by discipline; click a bar to see its items. Edit adds a tile and saves a version; Environment counts your projects; Present.

stages.title: Progress and trends
stages.tryIt: In Configuration → Progress type a plan (a date and a percentage per line). On a dashboard add Progress against the plan, Burn-up and Items by step over time: E1 records their numbers once a day, and the lines grow day by day.

stages.title: Dashboards in E1 Reviewer (the Progress card on the iPad)

In E1 Reviewer, Customize → Add Progress: the card shows the dashboard's numbers; tap it for the dashboard read-only, tap a number or a group for its items, and an item to open it.

milestones.title: Branches
milestones.summary: Git-like branches on the model: take part of the design into a branch, work apart from the shared design, pull others' changes, resolve conflicts object by object and on the drawing, and push back. Merge requests with review, branch types, automatic resolution rules, branch packages such as commissioning packages, and Alex working inside a branch.

stages.title: Pull and the conflict view

stages.title: Branches from the selection

stages.title: Automatic resolution rules
stages.tryIt: In Branch types…, set Graphical conflicts to Keep mine: a pull settles them by the rule, listed with it, and you can still take theirs.

stages.title: Branch packages

milestones.title: In parallel: integration API, company sign-on, access, chat modes

stages.tryIt: Open Sample E1 → Model Space → DF-20-P-0001: a production manifold and HP separator drawn as plant documentation, with four more P&IDs for heating, compression, flare and produced water.

stages.title: The sample project shows every part of E1
stages.tryIt: Open Sample E1: every section filled, from a pump with its motor to the single line and loop diagrams, cause and effect, workflows and the Demo Field status dashboard. Its drawings are drawn as by hand in E1, every line connected; ask Alex to check a P&ID for the mistakes left in on purpose.

stages.title: Sample E1: the sample project as a template, copied in seconds
stages.tryIt: File → New sample project (Sample E1): a copy of the template Sample E1 in a few seconds, with its drawings, documents and revisions, workflows, dashboard, branches, comments and markups. Its 2D spaces are named by drawing number, the title in Description.

stages.title: Excel import with the import wizard
stages.tryIt: File → Import Excel workbooks…: pick .xlsx or CSV files; each sheet is proposed as a class (Pumps → a kind of pump) and each column as an attribute (a unit in brackets is its unit). Check, decide the values E1 already holds, Apply; one Undo takes it back.

stages.title: DXF import with the import wizard
stages.tryIt: File → Import DXF…: each block is proposed as a class by its name and its look against E1's symbols, its TAG as its tag, each line layer as pipes or signals. Apply draws the 2D space with the symbols connected; one Undo takes it back.

stages.title: DWG files read directly
stages.tryIt: Import a DWG file without saving it as DXF first. Waits for the choice of DWG reader; until then E1 recognizes a DWG file and asks for it as DXF, which the same wizard imports with its mapping.

stages.title: PDF import (vector PDFs from CAD)
stages.tryIt: File → Import → PDF drawing…: pick the sheets of a CAD-exported P&ID set; shapes drawn alike are grouped with their picture and proposed by their look, texts (even drawn as strokes) become tags and line numbers pipelines. Accept all high, Ignore the rest, Apply: a connected 2D space per sheet

stages.title: PDF import measured on real P&ID sets; every mapping decision reversible
stages.tryIt: Import a CAD-exported P&ID set: the data tables and the title block are left out, and the project stays editable. On Mapping, Accept or Ignore pressed again undoes it; Accept all, Ignore all, Reset to suggestions, the To decide and Low confidence filters, and ticked rows decide many rows at once.

stages.title: Exports with the same mappings
stages.tryIt: In the Excel import wizard, Save mapping as Vendor tag list; import the next workbook with it (Saved mapping); File → Export with a saved mapping… writes the project in the same sheets, headers and units. DEXPI export comes with 13.5.

stages.title: Queries from a sentence and templates through the API
stages.tryIt: Right-click Assets → Query → From a sentence…, write "all pumps without a motor" and get the table; ask Alex the same; through the API, GET /projects/{id}/queries, POST /projects/{id}/queries/from-sentence and POST /projects/{id}/query.

stages.title: Hookups: Assets ▸ Hookups, an instrument's hookup, the hookup schedule
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Project settings → Hookups: tick Use hookups. Right-click Assets ▸ Hookups → New hookup…, choose it in an instrument's Hookup, then right-click Hookups → Hookup schedule → Export PDF.

stages.title: E1 Guide: search every lesson, All topics, go there
stages.tryIt: On a 2D space, open Alex → E1 Guide and search cause and effect: the lesson says where it is learned; Go there opens an object page and starts it. All topics lists every lesson by topic.

stages.title: E1 Guide: the topics tab, kinds of work, the chosen lesson in the panel
stages.tryIt: Open Alex → E1 Guide and click All topics: every lesson opens by topic in a tab of the main window. Click Configuration (or Design and diagrams) to narrow it, search, and click a lesson: it shows highlighted on the right; start it there. ✕ Close closes the tab.

stages.title: E1 Guide: compact lesson boxes, Read more, pinned lessons
stages.tryIt: Open Alex → E1 Guide: each lesson is a title with Read more under it. Click ☆ on a lesson: it moves under Pinned, at the top wherever you are, and stays after a reload; ★ unpins it.

stages.title: E1 Guide walk-through: every lesson taken in the real app
stages.tryIt: Every lesson of the E1 Guide is taken in the app by a test, and a bubble whose control is not on screen, with nothing saying how to show it, fails it. Nothing new on screen.

stages.title: E1 Guide: a bubble shows the way to a control that is not on screen
stages.tryIt: Start Place a symbol on a 2D space, then click the start page: the bubble says where the lesson is learned, and Take me there opens it on the same step. A bubble whose control opens from an earlier step offers Back to step N.

stages.title: E1 Guide: What is this?
stages.tryIt: Alex → E1 Guide → What is this? (or Shift+F1), then click Object on the drawing toolbar: instead of opening Add asset, a bubble says what it does and starts Place a symbol at that bubble.

stages.title: E1 Guide: whole jobs step by step, and What next
stages.tryIt: Alex → E1 Guide → Whole jobs, step by step → Show, then Draw your first P&ID: its lessons run one after the other with Next lesson. The last bubble of any lesson says What next?

stages.title: E1 Guide: Show me how, the idea first, then each step
stages.tryIt: On a unit's Cause and effect page, or any Configuration section, click Show me how at the top right: one page with a picture, the ideas and the work from start to finish; Show me step by step then runs its lessons on the screen.

stages.title: Simpler screens and missing controls found while writing the E1 Guide
stages.tryIt: Set a workflow step's criteria and approval in Edit flow…; New fieldbus segment… and Place on segment…; Cause and effect… on Systems; New query… on a section's toolbar; New hookup… in a window; Organization → Access in two groups; Alex's Show: filters.

milestones.title: E1 Reviewer for iPad
milestones.summary: E1's iPad app for reviewing away from the desk (Lanxtor/E1iPad, design 27), served by E1 at /reviewer/: search, a dashboard of cards, projects and their 2D spaces, an object's attributes, history, chat and files, photos and voice notes, redlines, tasks and checklists, and Alex in Ask mode. It obeys the same roles and edits no drawings. Not counted in the MVP progress.

stages.title: Sign-in, dashboard, projects, and search
stages.tryIt: On an iPad open https://app.lanxtor.com/reviewer/ in Safari, sign in, and Share → Add to Home Screen; arrange the dashboard cards and project tiles, and search for a tag.

stages.title: 2D spaces and the object page
stages.tryIt: Open a project's 2D space, pinch to zoom, tap a pump: its page shows attributes, history, chat and attachments, with previews of the 2D spaces it is on.

stages.title: Redlines, photos, voice notes, tasks, and checklists
stages.tryIt: Choose Redline and draw a cloud on a 2D space; add a photo and a voice note to an object; under For me, tick a checklist item of a task assigned to you.

stages.title: Alex in the reviewer
stages.tryIt: Open Alex in the reviewer: it starts in Ask mode; ask about the open project by typing or with the microphone, and nothing changes in the project.

stages.title: Live refresh
stages.tryIt: Keep Pump station open on the iPad while a colleague redlines it or comments on P-101 in E1: the redline and the comment appear without opening it again.

stages.title: Mentions, links, and checklists in E1
stages.tryIt: In the iPad's chat, @ Mention a colleague and # Link a tag: the link opens the object. In For me, rename or remove a checklist item; in E1's Inbox, Checklist under the task shows the same items.

stages.title: Review rounds, replies, and stamps with E1's redlining
stages.tryIt: In Redline on the iPad, choose the Review round, draw a cloud and place a stamp: they are E1's markups, numbered B-001 …; reply in the card's discussion, and Submit my redlines.

stages.title: Native sign-in and use on a real iPad
stages.tryIt: Sign in on an iPad without the extra question before returning to the app, and use the camera and the microphone on the device.

stages.title: Offline use
stages.tryIt: Open a project, go offline in a walk-down and add a redline and a comment: they show as Waiting to send and are sent, in order, when the connection is back.

stages.title: Terms and license agreement in the reviewer
stages.tryIt: Sign in on the iPad (or Try the demo) as someone who has not accepted the E1 Terms and License Agreement: it comes first, with its checkbox and Accept and continue. Profile → Terms and conditions shows it and when you accepted it.

milestones.title: After the MVP
milestones.summary: Beyond the MVP: DXF drawings converted into E1 symbols and lines through a saved mapping, also into a branch; DEXPI export of a 2D space for handover (13.5); wire harness, marine and partner content packages; message queues and more formats; a script step for stored assistants; voice input in the chat; markups as PDF comments and back; hook-up drawings; options, variants and the configurator for modules, and the built-in patterns as modules. Still open: a tested installation on a second cloud and on Alibaba Cloud (M4.16, M4.22). Not planned for now: connections and mappings to other systems (19.4).

stages.title: Named configurations: several for an organization, one per project, Change configuration… with a preview (design 11 Following)
stages.tryIt: Configuration → New configuration… copies the company configuration as Client X standard; Change configuration… on a project shows its preview and moves it; a new project follows the default configuration.

stages.title: Cyber Resilience Act and NERC CIP review, when a customer needs it (10-Q1, moved out of the MVP by the owner, 2026-11-12)
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: a compliance consultant or lawyer reviews E1's security and compliance file once a customer asks for it.

stages.title: Second cloud: Google Cloud (moved out of the MVP by the owner, 2026-11-12)
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: E1 runs from a second cloud account (Google Cloud, EU) from the same images as Azure.

stages.title: Enterprise installation on Alibaba Cloud: a tested installation (moved out of the MVP by the owner, 2026-11-12)
stages.tryIt: Behind the scenes: the same image runs in a trial Alibaba Cloud account with ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, OSS, the customer's sign-in provider, and Qwen through Model Studio for Alex; then the website shows Alibaba Cloud as available for enterprise installations.

stages.title: DEXPI export and handover
stages.tryIt: Click a 2D space in the explorer, then Export DEXPI on its page: a DEXPI 2.0 file of its pipelines, segments, equipment, instruments and drawing. Import it into an empty project: the same pipelines, segments and boundaries come back.

stages.title: Module options and variants
stages.tryIt: In a module's new version, add the option Drain valve and the variants Plain and With drain, set the drain valve to Only with Drain valve, and Publish. Place it as Plain, then Module ▾ → Change variant… → With drain: the drain valve and its pipe are placed.

stages.title: Patterns as modules
stages.tryIt: Ask Alex for a redundant pump train, then for a single pump with no standby: both are one instance of the module Redundant pump train, with its option Standby pump on or off. Ask for a control valve station without bypass; both modules are also under Modules.

stages.title: Module configurator and AI arrangement
stages.tryIt: Add asset → Modules → Configure…: type a strainer, then a pump with standby, and Propose: E1 chooses the modules, their variants and how they join. Arrange places them left to right, joined by pipes, as one change.

stages.title: CAD import (DXF, later DWG)
stages.tryIt: File → Import → DXF drawing…: its blocks become E1 symbols and its lines pipes, with a mapping you can save; in a branch the import lands in the branch until you push it. DWG files directly: 31.3b.

stages.title: Wire harness and marine content packages
stages.tryIt: Project settings → Content packages: switch on Marine (it brings Wire harness). Make a harness with its wires, connectors and splices under Assets, a fire zone and decks under Areas, and give a pump its deck and frame.

stages.title: Partner content packages
stages.tryIt: Configuration → Content and standards → Install a partner package…: choose a package a partner made and E1 reviewed and signed. Switch it on for a project in Project settings → Content packages, and create one of its classes.

stages.title: Message queues and more formats
stages.tryIt: File → Organization… → Webhooks: give an mqtts://, amqps:// or kafkas:// address to publish changes to a broker; Queue consumers runs command messages from one as an access token. A query exports to JSON and JSON Lines too.

stages.title: Script step for stored assistants
stages.tryIt: Open a stored assistant, Add script step and calculate a size and a tag from its parameters; a later step uses them as {s1c.result.tag}. Run it: the object gets the tag the script composed.

stages.title: Voice input
stages.tryIt: Press the microphone in the chat, speak, press it again: the text appears in the composer to edit before you send it.

stages.title: Live voice input: the words while you speak
stages.tryIt: Press the microphone in Alex's chat or in Feedback and speak: your words appear in the box as you say them, and pressing it again only adds the last ones.

stages.title: Connections and mappings to other systems (dropped from the MVP, I-D16)
stages.tryIt: Not planned for now: a customer's own script or middleware maps and schedules through the API. Set up a connection with a field mapping and run it.

stages.title: Markups as PDF annotations, and field walkdowns
stages.tryIt: Markups → Marked-up print: each markup is a PDF comment a reviewer sees in their PDF tool. Import annotated PDF… brings their comments back as markups in the round; in the field, mark up on E1 Reviewer for iPad in a walkdown round.

stages.title: Hook-up drawings, impulse lines, and installation details
stages.tryIt: Open a hookup and click Hookup drawing; choose Differential pressure, Steam and a 5-valve manifold: the sketch shows the tappings, pots and sloped impulse lines. Fill bill of material lists the parts; Export PDF gives the A3 drawing.

milestones.title: Parked: Power (IEC 61850)
milestones.summary: Parked by the owner (2026-11-05, 00-D12): not part of the MVP, not scheduled, and it may never be built. Formerly M9: substation engineering following IEC 61850, SCL import and export, generated single-line diagrams.

stages.title: Power library content and topology
stages.tryIt: Build a substation with voltage levels, bays, primary equipment, and IEDs in the tree.

stages.title: SCL import
stages.tryIt: Import an SCL file and see the substation appear in the model.

stages.title: SCL export with schema validation
stages.tryIt: Export the substation as an SCL file that passes schema validation.

stages.title: Single-line diagrams
stages.tryIt: Generate a single-line diagram from the substation model and open it.

stages.title: The power (PTD) content package
stages.tryIt: Switch on the power (PTD) content package and see its classes and symbols.

milestones.title: Pages and content
milestones.summary: The marketing site for LANXTOR E1: home, solutions, industries, pricing with Editor, Reviewer and Viewer licenses, about, user guides, downloads, sign-in and the account page, and the Shape E1 board where people post and vote on feature requests.

stages.title: The LANXTOR E1 marketing website
stages.tryIt: Open the preview site: the home page, Solutions, Industries and About pages are there.

stages.title: Pricing, Shape E1 board, and a richer Solutions page
stages.tryIt: Open Pricing: Editor, Reviewer and Viewer licenses, the 30-day trial, content packages. Open Contact us (Shape E1): post a request and vote.

stages.title: Account portal, three-platform downloads, Academy in the account page
stages.tryIt: Open Get E1: Windows, macOS and Linux with your own system first. Open the account page: preview data with licenses, AI usage, storage, projects and the Academy.

stages.title: Focus on production plants and energy
stages.tryIt: Read the home and Solutions pages: the copy speaks to production plants and energy.

milestones.title: Hosting and launch
milestones.summary: The site moves from Netlify to Azure Static Web Apps, lanxtor.com's DNS moves to Azure DNS without breaking mail, and the full site goes live in place of the coming-soon page (docs/AZURE-INTEGRATION.md in Lanxtor/E1Website).

stages.title: Azure Static Web Apps workflow, coming-soon page, preview site
stages.tryIt: lanxtor.com shows the coming-soon page; preview.lanxtor.com (password-protected) shows the full site.

stages.title: DNS Phase A: lanxtor.com DNS on Azure, mail kept
stages.tryIt: dig +short NS lanxtor.com shows the Azure nameservers; mail to and from lanxtor.com still works.

stages.title: DNS Phase B: www, apex, and app.lanxtor.com on Azure
stages.tryIt: www.lanxtor.com and lanxtor.com open from Azure with a certificate; app.lanxtor.com opens the E1 server.

stages.title: Netlify retired
stages.tryIt: The Netlify site and DNS zone are deleted; TTLs raised to 3600.

stages.title: Launch: the full site on lanxtor.com (SITE_MODE = live)
stages.tryIt: Open lanxtor.com: the full site instead of "Coming soon."

milestones.title: Connected to the E1 cloud
milestones.summary: One account for the app and the website: "Log in" signs in through the E1 server, the account page reads licenses, usage, projects and billing from it, and the Shape E1 board stores posts and votes in E1's PostgreSQL.

stages.title: Website pointed at app.lanxtor.com; account API and board routes on the server
stages.tryIt: assets/js/config.js points at https://app.lanxtor.com; the server answers /api/account/overview and /api/community/* (server/tests/website.test.mjs).

stages.title: Sign-in from the website end to end
stages.tryIt: On the website choose Log in, sign in, and land back on the account page with your real license and projects (needs app M2.8, cloud deployment).

stages.title: Shape E1 board live on the server
stages.tryIt: Post a request on Shape E1 while signed in, reload in another browser: it is there, with its votes.

stages.title: Academy courses served by the E1 server
stages.tryIt: The account page lists video courses with your progress and certificates instead of "Video courses are on their way".

milestones.title: Commerce and downloads
milestones.summary: People can buy and manage subscriptions through a billing provider's portal, and download signed installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux from the release manifest.

stages.title: Billing provider and the billing portal
stages.tryIt: On the account page choose Manage billing: the provider's portal opens to change plan, seats, and payment method.

stages.title: First signed installers in the release manifest
stages.tryIt: Open Get E1: the installer for your system downloads, with its size and SHA-256.
